summary.text: Tony Williams, listed by Ballotpedia as Anthony Williams, is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania State Senate, representing District 8 since December 1, 1998, after serving in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 1988 to 1998; he is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, and Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Williams earned a bachelor's degree in economics from Franklin and Marshall College in 1979, and his professional experience includes working as an executive at PepsiCo.
Ballotpedia lists him as a candidate in the Democratic primaries for mayor of Philadelphia in 2015 and 2019; James Kenney won both.
For 2025 and 2026 Williams was assigned to the Community, Economic and Recreational Development, Banking and Insurance, Education, and State Government committees.
